ISKCON Kolkata Removes Vice President Amid Controversy

ISKCON Kolkata has removed its Vice President, Radharaman Das, from his position. The removal follows a controversy, with Das having previously posted six potential reasons for his ouster on social media, though the post was later deleted. He has also been barred from speaking on behalf of the organization.
